ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Applications are invited for two (02) positions of Guest Faculty in the Department of Physics, Panjab
University, and Chandigarh to teach B.Sc, M.Sc and PG Diploma Courses running in the Department
classes for the Odd Semester of the Academic Session 2026-2027.
Days of Teaching Classes to be taught Subject to be taught Working hours
Monday to Friday B.Sc/M.Sc/PG Diploma
courses running in the
Department
Physics as available in
the Syllabus
9.00 am to 5.00pm
Interested candidates are required to submit the hard copy of the application along with the self attested
copies of relevant certificates and documents to the office of the Chairperson, Department of Physics,
Panjab University, Chandigarh by 27.07.2026 (Monday) till 5.00 p.m . The application form for the post
of Assistant Professor is available on the website.
http://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf
No TA.DA will be paid for attending the interview. All the applicants are advised to bring their original
certificates and other relevant documents for verification at the time of interview.
The above assignment will be on lecture basis, with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture, and an
upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not
draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency as long as they are teaching in
the Physics Department as a Guest Faculty. The candidates who are already availing JRF scholarships in
the University are not entitled for the honorarium but they will be issued experience certificate for the
Guest Faculty in case they are selected.
Minimum qualifications for the post is as per UGC norms.
Chairperson
